name: 10th Joint ACTRIMS-ECTRIMS Meeting (MSToronto 2026)
organizer: European Committee for Treatment and Research in Multiple Sclerosis (ECTRIMS) and Americas Committee for Treatment and Research in Multiple Sclerosis (ACTRIMS)
description: ECTRIMS and ACTRIMS hold their tenth joint congress in Toronto, Canada, from 21 to 23 October 2026 at the Metro Toronto Convention Centre. The meeting, also known as MSToronto 2026, covers multiple sclerosis research and clinical care.
